svg.title: Quest map of the playable ship slice
svg.desc: The boat deck, the storage room, and the battle arena drawn from the real game art, with eight numbered quest steps, the routes walked in the two cutscenes, placed where they happen and the tag each step sets.
svg.text: win: back to the same spot

g.text: Use the lantern at the bow

svg.text: ■ red = door regions ■ green = special ground
Gold = tag it sets · dotted = cutscene walk
